info.title: Helia API
info.description: Solar lucky-imaging stacker. All paths are relative to the server's data root.

get.summary: One frame of a capture as an auto-stretched 8-bit greyscale PNG.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Capture path relative to the data root.

parameters.name: max_width
parameters.description: Downscale to at most this width (16 to 8192).

parameters.name: bayer
parameters.description: Bayer handling, as for jobs: `auto` (default), `none` or a pattern.

parameters.name: bit_depth
parameters.description: Bits per sample instead of the SER header's.

parameters.name: flip_rows
parameters.description: Read the rows bottom to top.

post.summary: Header information for a `.ser`, `.avi` or video capture, without reading frames.

get.summary: A small HTML page that lists the operations of the `OpenAPI` document; needs no token.
Liveness probe. Always answers `{"status":"ok"}`; needs no token.
Remembered jobs, oldest first. The newest 100 finished jobs are kept.

post.summary: Queue a stack. Answers `202` with the job; poll it or follow its events.

get.summary: One job: state, stage, progress, timings and summary.

delete.summary: Cancel a queued or running job, or forget a finished one.
delete.description: A finished job's output file stays on disk.

get.summary: WebSocket stream of job events: a snapshot, then state and progress messages.
get.description: The server closes the stream after the final state message.

101.description: WebSocket; text frames are JobEvent JSON

get.summary: An 8-bit PNG of the result (square-root stretch). Only once the job has succeeded.

parameters.name: max_width
parameters.description: Downscale to at most this width (16 to 8192; stored previews are at most 2048 wide).

get.summary:
The science report of a finished job that asked for `report`: one
self-contained HTML page with the figures, tables and settings.

404.description: the job did not ask for a report (`report_missing`)

get.summary:
One file of the science report: a figure (`quality-sorted.png`), its data
(`frame-quality.csv`, `frame-quality.json`) or `fits-header.txt`. The files
are listed in `summary.report.files`.

200.description: the file, with the matching content type

get.summary: The written TIFF or FITS file, streamed. Only once the job has succeeded.

200.description: the stacked TIFF, PNG or FITS file

get.summary: The sunspot table of a finished job that asked for `sunspots`, as CSV.

404.description: the job did not ask for sunspots (`sunspots_missing`)

get.summary:
The sunspot overlay of a finished job that asked for `sunspots`: the flattened
disc with penumbra, umbra and group numbers drawn on it.

404.description: the job did not ask for sunspots (`sunspots_missing`)

post.summary: Join panels of the Sun into a full-disc mosaic.
post.description:
Stack every panel first, with the same settings, using ordinary jobs. The
request runs to the end before it answers.

422.description: bad settings, panels that do not match, or no time for a derotation

get.summary: `GET /presets`: the filter presets, their recommended settings and colours.
A preset's colour table as a file other programs read.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Entries, 2 to 4096 (default 256; an `imagej` table always has 256).

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: Mix of colour and grey, 0 to 1 (default 1).

200.description: the table: a .cube, .csv, ImageJ .lut or a PNG strip

422.description: a bad format, size or strength

post.summary: Bring images of the Sun to one time by its differential rotation.
post.description:
Each image is derotated on its own, about the disc fitted to it; the
result is not shifted, so use the time-lapse (or a mosaic) to register them.

409.description: a result exists and `overwrite` is false (`output_exists`)

422.description: bad settings, no time, or no clear disc

post.summary:
Register stacked images to each other and write a time-lapse: numbered
frames, a registration table and a movie.
post.description:
Stack every capture first, with the same settings, using ordinary jobs. The
request runs to the end before it answers; a long series with an MP4 can take
a while.

409.description: `output` already holds a time-lapse and `overwrite` is false (`output_exists`)

422.description: bad settings, fewer than two inputs, or an input that is not a stacked image

get.summary: Server version, backend availability, limits and whether a token is required.
get.description: The GPU is probed once, on first use.

AlignmentSummary.description: Global alignment: the method that ran, why, and its confidence.

confidence.description: Mean confidence of the frames, 0 to 1. Absent when it was not measured.

confidence_min.description: Least confidence of any frame, 0 to 1.

fallbacks.description: Frames that wanted the limb fit but were aligned by phase correlation.

limb.description: Fitted limb of the reference: centre x, centre y and radius, pixels.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence (for `auto`, whether the full disc was in view).

sampled.description: The confidence comes from a sample of the frames (a GPU run).

AutoApSummary.description: What automatic alignment points chose and what they were based on.

arcsec_per_pixel.description:
Image scale from the fitted limb, arcseconds per pixel. Absent when
there was no limb.

search_radius.description: Search radius around the global shift, pixels.

warp_px.description:
Local warp of the seeing, pixels (root mean square distance of an
alignment point's shift from its frame's median). Absent when too few
points locked.

BuildDetails.description: How the server binary was built.

commit.description: Short git commit hash (`unknown` outside a git checkout).

dirty.description: Built from a tree with uncommitted changes.

CalibrationConfig.description:
Calibration masters for a job. Each path is relative to the data root and
names a master file (FITS, from `helia calibrate`) or raw calibration
frames to build one from (a SER, AVI or FITS file, or a folder of them).

bad_pixels.description:
Bad-pixel map: a FITS map from `helia calibrate`, or a text file with
an `x y` pair (from 0, top-left) on each line.

bias.description: Master bias, or bias captures. Only used with `scale_dark`.

combine.description:
How frames are combined into a master: `median`, `sigma` or `sigma:K`.
Default `sigma`.

cosmetic.description:
Without `bad_pixels`, find the hot pixels of the dark and the cold ones
of the flat and correct them. Default `true`.

displaced.description:
Captures of the Sun at many places on the sensor, to solve a flat from
when there is no `flat` (self-calibration: dust and fringes included).
The dark is taken off first. Excludes `flat`.

flat_dark.description: Dark captures at the exposure of the flats, when `flat` is captures.

scale_dark.description:
Scale the dark by the ratio of the exposures (read from the `SharpCap`
sidecar of the capture).

codec.description: Video codec (`h264`, ...), for video read through ffmpeg.

colour.description:
Pixel layout: `mono`, `bayer`, `rgb`, `bgr`, or `video` for compressed
video, which ffmpeg converts to luminance or one colour channel.

oneOf.description: The mosaic test, when it was run (a SER file labelled mono, no override).

effective.description: What Helia decodes the capture with, and where each value came from.

format.description:
`ser`, `avi`, or the extension of a video read through ffmpeg (`mp4`,
`mov`, `mkv`, `webm`, `m4v`; also `avi` for a compressed AVI).

oneOf.description: The SER header exactly as written in the file.

notices.description: What to tell the user about how the file was read.

overrides.description: The overrides in force, as command-line flags.

path.description: Capture path relative to the data root.

quality_note.description:
Quality caveat when the input is lossy video, for example "lossy 8-bit
4:2:0 video (h264): fine for quick results, SER/AVI raw captures keep
more detail".

recommended.description: The settings a job would use if none were given.

oneOf.description: `SharpCap` sidecar, when one sits next to the capture.

ChannelArg.description: Colour plane taken from a Bayer capture.

ChannelSummary.description: How red and blue were registered to green in a true-colour stack.

applied.description:
The plane was moved. False when the shift was too small, too large or
not trustworthy.

DerotateConfig.description:
How the Sun's differential rotation is undone (`derotate` of a time-lapse,
and the settings of `POST /solar-derotation`); every field is optional.

celestial_north_up.description:
The images have celestial north up: solar north is turned by the
position angle P at each image's time, on top of `north_angle_deg`.

law.description:
`howard` (default), `snodgrass`, or `A,B,C`: degrees a day for
`A + B sin^2 + C sin^4` of the latitude (`A` positive).

mirror.description: The images are mirror images (west on the left).

north_angle_deg.description:
Degrees counter-clockwise from the top of the image to solar north
(default 0).

raw_brightness.description:
Move the pixel values as they are, not the contrast against the limb
darkening.

to.description:
The time to bring every image to, UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`). Default:
the reference frame's time in a time-lapse, the middle time of the
images in `POST /solar-derotation` (which also takes `first`, `middle`
and `last`).

centre_shift_px.description: The same at the disc centre.

disc.description: The disc found in the input: centre x, centre y, radius, pixels.

file.description: The result, relative to the data root.

max_shift_px.description: The most any pixel of the disc came from, pixels.

DetectionInfo.description: The test for a hidden Bayer mosaic.

position_means.description:
Mean level (0 to 1) of the pixels at even x/even y, odd x/even y,
even x/odd y and odd x/odd y.

reason.description: Why it could not tell, for `inconclusive`.

red_blue_basis.description: How red was told from blue, for `mosaic`.

region.description: Area measured: x, y, width, height.

spread.description: (largest - smallest) / average of the four means.

EffectiveInfo.description: What Helia decodes the capture with.

flip_rows.description: Rows are read bottom to top.

code.description: Stable `snake_case` identifier, safe to match on.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Envelope returned for every non-2xx response.

FieldRotationConfig.description: How to undo the field rotation of an altazimuth mount.

mirror.description:
The picture is a mirror image (an odd number of reflections): the turn
is the other way.

reference.description:
The orientation every frame is turned to: `middle` (default), `first`
or `last`.

FieldRotationSummary.description: What undoing the field rotation did.

altitude_deg.description: Altitude of the Sun at the reference, degrees.

frames_stamped.description: Frames that had a timestamp of their own.

limb_shift_px.description:
Displacement at the limb, pixels, of the frame that turned most; absent
without a fitted limb.

lines.description: The report in lines, as the command line prints it.

max_turn_deg.description: Largest turn applied to a frame, degrees.

rate_deg_per_min.description: Mean rate of rotation, degrees per minute.

reference_angle_deg.description: Parallactic angle at the reference, degrees.

reference_time.description:
The orientation every frame was turned to: the time of that frame,
ISO 8601 UTC.

span_deg.description: Parallactic angle from the first frame to the last, degrees.

available.description: A GPU backend can be created (a software adapter counts).

software.description: The adapter is a software rasteriser.

GranulationSummary.description: Granulation statistics of the stack (`helia measure`, the quality report).

arcsec_per_pixel.description: Image scale, arcseconds per pixel (absent without a fitted limb).

cell_diameter_px.description: Mean diameter of whole granules, pixels.

cutoff_freq.description:
Diffraction cut-off `D / lambda` in cycles per pixel; needs
`aperture_mm` and a fitted limb.

lines.description: The report in lines, as the command line prints it.

resolved_freq.description: Highest frequency (cycles per pixel) above 1% of the peak power.

rms_contrast.description:
Standard deviation over mean of the flattened disc-centre region (a
fraction, 0.04 is 4%).

rolloff_freq.description:
Spatial frequency (cycles per pixel) where the noise-subtracted power
spectrum has fallen to 10% of its peak.

bayer.description:
`auto` (default), `none`, `rggb`, `grbg`, `gbrg` or `bggr`: see what an
override would change.

bit_depth.description: Bits per sample instead of the SER header's (1 to 16).

endian.description: `little` or `big`, instead of the SER header flag.

flip_rows.description: Read the rows bottom to top.

path.description: Capture path relative to the data root.

align.description:
How whole frames are aligned: `auto` (fit the solar limb when the full
disc is in view and the fit is confident, else phase correlation),
`phase`, or `limb`. The choice and its confidence come back in
`summary.alignment`.

align_channels.description:
With `colour: "true"`, register red and blue to green (atmospheric
dispersion). Default `true`.

ap_auto.description:
Choose the alignment point size, spacing and search range from the
image scale (the fitted limb) and the seeing (a probe of a dozen
frames). Excludes `ap_size`; needs `multipoint`. What was chosen comes
back in `summary.auto_ap`.

ap_passes.description:
Alignment point passes, 1 or 2. 2 stacks once and measures the points
again against that stack. Default 1; needs `multipoint`.

ap_residual.description:
Measure the alignment points once more against the finished stack, for
the residual figure of the `report` (`ap-residual.png`). Costs one more
registration pass. Needs `multipoint`.

ap_size.description:
Alignment point size in pixels (8 to 1024). Absent: chosen from the
image size.

ap_smooth.description:
Replace alignment point shifts that disagree with their neighbours by
the neighbours' median. Needs `multipoint`.

aperture_mm.description:
Telescope aperture in millimetres, for the diffraction cut-off in
`summary.granulation` and for `r0` in `summary.seeing`.

autocrop.description:
Crop the result to the solar disc plus `autocrop_margin`, FITS too. A
capture without a clear disc is left uncropped; `summary.crop` is then
absent.

autocrop_margin.description:
Margin of `autocrop` as a percentage of the disc radius, 0 to 200.
Default 10.

bayer.description:
`auto`, `none`, `rggb`, `grbg`, `gbrg` or `bggr`. `auto` trusts the
file's header, but checks a SER file labelled mono for a hidden Bayer
mosaic and debayers when it finds one. `none` treats the frames as
mono whatever the header says; a pattern forces it.

bit_depth.description:
Bits per sample instead of the SER header's (1 to 8 read one byte per
pixel, 9 to 16 two). SER only.

oneOf.description:
Dark, flat and bad-pixel calibration, applied to every frame before it
is demosaiced, scored or aligned. Absent: none.

Colour plane to stack from a Bayer capture. Absent: the preset's
channel, else `lum`.

colour.description:
Colour of the output: `auto` (the preset in force), `mono`, a preset
id, or `true`. `true` is true colour from a raw colour camera: red,
green and blue stacked on one alignment, channels aligned, white
balanced, written as an RGB TIFF or PNG or a three-plane FITS cube; it
needs a Bayer capture and excludes `channel`, `invert` and
`colour_strength`. The other looks colour a `.tif` or `.png` from the
mono stack, and FITS output is mono and unaltered for them. Absent: the
`preset`'s colours if one was given, else mono.

colour_strength.description: Mix of colour and grey, 0 to 1.

date.description:
When the capture was taken, UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`), for a capture
that does not hold its own time (an AVI or a video; a SER's time stamps
are used otherwise). Gives P, B0 and L0 to `sunspots` and to the
heliographic grids of `report`.

detect_overlay.description: Look for burned-in text (a `SharpCap` timestamp) and mask it.

disc_mask.description: Fit the limb and place alignment points on the disc only.

edits.description:
Further edits, applied in order after `sharpen`: objects with an `op`
of `unsharp`, `wavelet`, `deconvolve`, `denoise`, `levels`, `curve`,
`crop`, `rotate`, `flip` or `resize` and that operation's parameters
(see the sharpening and adjustments page of the user guide). Unset
parameters take their defaults.

endian.description:
Byte order of 16-bit samples instead of the SER header flag:
`little` or `big`. SER only.

exclude.description:
Rectangles to keep alignment and scoring off. They are flattened in
every frame and so are flat in the result. Burned-in timestamps are
found automatically (see `detect_overlay`).

oneOf.description:
Undo the field rotation of an altazimuth mount: every frame is turned to
one orientation from the parallactic angle of the Sun at its SER
timestamp, before it is scored, aligned or stacked. Needs `site` (or the
server's `HELIA_SITE`) and a capture with timestamps; what it did is in
`summary.field_rotation`. An empty object takes the defaults; not for an
equatorial mount, and not with `colour: "true"`.

flatten.description:
Flatten the disc's limb darkening before anything else: `model`
(divide by the fitted law) or `profile` (divide by the measured
azimuthal median). Outside the limb nothing changes. It runs first, so
`sharpen` and `edits` see flat contrast. A capture with no clear disc is
left as it is and `summary.limb_darkening` is absent.

flip_rows.description: Read the rows bottom to top. SER only.

grade.description:
Colour grading on top of the look: `hue=DEG,sat=S,gamma=G,black=B,
white=W,r=R,g=G,b=B`, any of them (hue -180 to 180, sat 0 to 2, gamma 0.3
to 3, black 0 to 0.9, white 0.1 to 1, r, g and b channel curves 0.3 to
3). Absent: no grading. Not with `colour: "true"`.

invert.description: Invert before colouring (shows filaments and prominences).

keep.description: Share (`"25%"`) or count (`"500"`) of frames to keep. Default `25%`.

keep_frames.description: Number of frames to keep; excludes `keep`.

limb_law.description:
The limb-darkening law fitted to the stack and used by `flatten`:
`linear`, `quadratic` (the default) or `neckel` (five terms). The fit
comes back in `summary.limb_darkening` whether or not `flatten` is set.

multipoint.description: Multi-point alignment; `false` is global alignment only.

plugin_steps.description:
Steps of plugins to run, each `PLUGIN/STEP`, optionally followed by
`:KEY=VALUE,KEY=VALUE` or `:{"json":"object"}` for its parameters and
optionally preceded by `pre:` for an image step that runs before
`sharpen` and `edits`. A `frame-op` step runs on every frame before it
is scored; an `image-op` step on the stack (after `sharpen` and `edits`
unless `pre:`); an `analyse` step on the result, and what it reports comes
back in `summary.plugins`. The plugins must have been enabled on the
server (`helia plugins enable`); a plugin that is off, changed or
unknown, or a value outside the step's range, is a 422. They run with
the rights of the server. At most 16.

preset.description:
Filter preset (`ha`, `cak`, `cah`, `mg`, `na`, `he-d3`, `hbeta`,
`white`; see `GET /presets`): its channel and frame share apply
wherever `channel` and `keep` are absent, and a `.tif` or `.png`
output is coloured with it. Absent: the filter is detected from the file
name, folder, sidecar or header, for the settings only.

prominence_band.description:
Pixels outside the fitted limb where alignment points are still
allowed; 0 keeps them on the disc.

report.description:
Make the science report: the frame quality graphs (sorted and in
capture order, with the keep threshold), the quality histogram, the
global shift and drift and the seeing over the capture, as PNG with
their data as CSV and JSON, and one self-contained HTML page. Turns
the seeing probe on (about 120 more frames are read). The files are
listed in `summary.report`; fetch them with
`GET /jobs/{id}/report` and `GET /jobs/{id}/report/{file}`.

oneOf.description:
Outlier-robust combination: `none` (the default weighted mean),
`sigma`, `huber` or `winsor`. Excludes `sigma_clip`.

robust_k.description:
Threshold of `robust` in standard deviations. Default 2.5 for `sigma`,
1.345 for `huber`, 2 for `winsor`.

seeing.description:
Estimate the seeing from the capture (`summary.seeing`): the Fried
parameter from the spectral ratio, which needs `aperture_mm`, and a
relative alignment point motion index.

sharpen.description:
Sharpening of the stack: `wavelet` (Registax-style layers, the usual
choice), `unsharp`, `rl` (Richardson-Lucy) or `none`, with the
recommended values of the filter in force. Absent: `none`. It runs
first, on the mono image, before `edits` and before any colour.

sharpen_fits.description:
Apply `sharpen` and `edits` to FITS output too. By default a FITS file
is the unsharpened stack.

sigma_clip.description:
Sigma clipping threshold in standard deviations; off when absent.
Same as `robust: "sigma"` with `robust_k`.

site.description:
Observing site as `"lat,lon,alt"` (degrees north, degrees east, metres),
written to a FITS output as `OBSGEO-X/Y/Z`. Absent: the server's
`HELIA_SITE` environment variable, else the keywords are left out.

stack_backend.description:
Stack with this `stack-backend` plugin instead of on the server's own
pipeline. Not with `report`, true colour, calibration or field rotation.

oneOf.description:
Find the sunspots on the stack (`summary.sunspots`, the `SPOT*` FITS
cards, `GET /jobs/{id}/sunspots.csv` and `sunspots.png`). An empty
object takes the defaults. For a white-light capture with the whole
disc in view.

wavelets.description:
Wavelets as in RegiStax 6, replacing the recommended layers: the
`registax:` form of the CLI's `--wavelets`, for example
`registax:l1=100/0.14/0.2,l2=100/0.11/0.15,scheme=dyadic,filter=gaussian`.
A layer is `amount/sharpen[/denoise]` (amount 0 to 200 %, sharpen -0.1
to 1, denoise 0 to 1.5); the gain is `1 + amount * sharpen * |sharpen|`
(0.14 at 100 % is 3x, 1 is 101x) and the noise cut
`10 * denoise * amount / 100` noise sigmas. Other keys: `scheme`
(`dyadic` or `linear`), `filter` (`default` or `gaussian`), `initial`,
`step`, `linked` (`on`). Implies `sharpen: "wavelet"`; with
`sharpen: "rl"` the wavelets run after the deconvolution (the usual
order: deconvolve, then lift and denoise); excludes `unsharp`.

white_balance.description:
White balance of `colour: "true"`: `auto` (make the disc centre
neutral), `off` (the sensor's own balance) or `"R,G,B"` gains such as
`"1.9,1,1.5"`. Default `auto`. Only with `colour: "true"`.

oneOf.description: Full job view, sent once on connect.
State change.
Failure reason when `failed`.
Progress tick.

input.description: Capture path (`.ser` or `.avi`), relative to the data root.

alignment.description: How whole frames were aligned, and how confident that was.

alignment_points_total.description: Alignment points in the grid (multi-point only).

oneOf.description: What `ap_auto` chose. Absent when it was off.

bayer.description: Bayer pattern the frames were decoded with (`rggb` ...); absent for mono.

calibration.description:
The calibration masters applied, one line each, and any warning about
them (a flat with rings, a dark that could not be scaled). Empty when
the job had no `calibration`.

colour.description: How the output was coloured, in words; absent for a mono output.

oneOf.description:
The region `autocrop` kept, in the pixels of the stacked image before
the crop. Absent when it was off or found no disc (see `notices`).

edited.description: The edits were applied to the pixels of the output.

edits.description:
The edits recorded in the output file, one line each. For FITS output
without `sharpen_fits` this is the note that the file is unedited.

oneOf.description: What the field rotation correction did, with `field_rotation` set.

filter.description: Preset id in force (chosen or detected), if any.

filter_source.description: Where the filter was read from (`chosen`, or the text it was found in).

oneOf.description:
Granulation report of the unsharpened stack, for the white-light and
sodium filters. Absent for other filters or when the disc centre has
no usable signal.

The limb-darkening law fitted to the stack. Absent when there was no
clear disc.

notices.description:
Things worth knowing about how the capture was read, such as a Bayer
mosaic found in a file whose header says mono.

plugins.description: What the `analyse` steps of plugins reported, with `plugin_steps` set.

oneOf.description: The files of the science report, with `report` set.
The seeing estimated from the capture, with `seeing` on.

Whether the sharpening added detail or mostly noise, from the bands of
the stack before and after the edits. Absent when nothing was edited or
the edits changed the image size.

stacked_by.description: The `stack-backend` plugin that made the stack, with `stack_backend` set.

oneOf.description: Sunspots found on the stack, with `sunspots` set.
What true colour did. Absent unless `colour` was `true`.
Failure reason.

input.description: Input path relative to the data root.

output.description: Output path relative to the data root.

queue_position.description: Position among queued jobs (0 is next), while queued.

run_seconds.description: Seconds spent running so far or in total.

stage_progress.description: Progress within the current stage, 0 to 1.

oneOf.description: Result summary once succeeded.

timings.description: Per-stage wall times of a finished run.

LimbSummary.description: A limb-darkening law fitted to the stack's azimuthal median profile.

coefficients.description:
The coefficients, `I(mu) / I(1) = 1 - sum c_k (1 - mu^k)` for `neckel`,
`1 - u (1 - mu) - u2 (1 - mu)^2` for the others.

limb_level.description: The law at the limb as a share of the disc centre.

names.description: Names of the coefficients, in order (`u1`, `u2`, or `a1` to `a5`).

rms.description:
Root mean square departure of the profile from the law, as a share of
the centre intensity.

MosaicPair.description: How a pair of panels matched.

ncc.description: Normalised correlation of the detail on the overlap.

residual_px.description: How far the pair is from where the placement put it, pixels.

used.description: Whether it was used in the placement.

angle_deg.description: Rotation against the first panel, degrees (clockwise on screen).

derotated_px.description:
The most the derotation moved the surface of this panel, pixels, when it
ran.

gain.description: Gain applied for the brightness match.

offset.description: Offset applied for the brightness match.

x.description: Shift in the mosaic's coordinates, pixels (the first panel is at 0).

oneOf.description:
Bring every panel to one time by the Sun's differential rotation first (an
empty object for the defaults; `to` may be `first`, `middle` (default),
`last` or a UTC time).

feather_px.description:
Width of the blend across a seam and at a panel's edge, pixels (0 to 200,
default 12).

gain_match.description: Match the panels' gain and offset on the overlaps (default true).

inputs.description:
Stacked panels (`.tif`, `.tiff`, `.png`, `.fits`) relative to the data root,
2 to 64. The first is the reference: the mosaic is in its orientation and
brightness.

max_rotation_deg.description:
The most the panels may be turned against each other, degrees (0 to 45,
default 4; 0 holds them square).

min_correlation.description:
Least normalised correlation of the detail on an overlap, 0 to 1 (default
0.45).

min_overlap_percent.description: Least overlap that counts, percent of the smaller panel (default 5).

output.description:
The mosaic to write, relative to the data root; the extension picks the
format. The panel and pair tables are written beside it as
`NAME-panels.csv` and `NAME-pairs.csv`.

seams.description: Join along seams of least difference (default true).

times.description:
UTC time of each panel, in the order given (needed for `derotate`).
Without it a FITS file's `DATE-AVG` or a file name with a full date and time
is used.

derotated_to.description: The time the panels were brought to, UTC, when they were derotated.

disc.description: The disc fitted to the mosaic: centre x, centre y, radius, pixels.

output.description: The mosaic, relative to the data root.

overlap_rms.description: RMS difference of the panels over the whole overlap, the same measure.

pairs_table.description: The pair table (CSV), relative to the data root.

panels_table.description: The panel table (CSV), relative to the data root.

seam_rms.description: RMS difference of the panels beside a seam, as a share of the level there.

NoticeInfo.description: A message about how the capture was understood.

PluginSummary.description: What one `analyse` step of a plugin reported.

overlays.description:
Shapes in pixels of the output image, origin top-left: objects with a `kind` of
`circle`, `rect`, `line`, `points` or `text`.

PresetColour.description: The colour parameters of a preset.

gamma.description: Tone exponent applied before colouring (below 1 brightens).

mid_grey_rgb.description: What a mid-grey (0.5) becomes, 8-bit red, green, blue.

PresetSharpen.description:
The recommended sharpening values of a preset (what `sharpen` in a job
uses for this filter).

reason.description: Why they are what they are.

wavelet_noise.description: Wavelet noise threshold of layers 1 to 6, in noise sigmas.

colour.description: Colour parameters. Colour is presentation, not measurement.

id.description: Id to give as `preset` or `colour` in a job: `ha`, `cak`, ...

reason.description: Why the recommendations are what they are.

summary.description: One line on what it is for.

wavelength.description: Wavelength as printed in the docs.

Recommended.description: What Helia would do with a capture if given no settings.

filter.description: Preset id detected from the file name, folder, sidecar or SER header.

filter_source.description: The text the filter was read from.

keep_percent.description: Share of frames it would keep, percent.

Region.description: A rectangle of the frame, in pixels from the top-left corner.

ReportSummary.description: The science report of a job.

files.description:
File names: `report.html`, the figures (`*.png`) and their data
(`*.csv`, `*.json`). Fetch one with `GET /jobs/{id}/report/{file}`.

not_drawn.description: Figures that were not drawn, and why (for example, no seeing data).

RobustArg.description: Outlier-robust combination of the frames at each pixel.

d_over_r0.description: `D / r0` from the spectral ratio; needs `aperture_mm`.

frames.description: Frames followed (spread over the whole capture).

lines.description: The report in lines, as the command line prints it.

motion_arcsec.description: The same in arcseconds, with a fitted limb.

motion_px.description:
RMS differential motion between neighbouring alignment points, per
axis, pixels. A relative index, not `r0`.

r0_cm.description: Fried parameter at the capture's wavelength, centimetres.

SerHeaderInfo.description: A SER header exactly as written in the file, decoded.

oneOf.description: Timestamps in the trailer.

SharpenCheckSummary.description:
Did the sharpening add detail, or mostly noise (see the sharpening page of
the user guide).

detail_gain.description: The 1 to 4 pixel band of the stack after the edits over before.

noise_gain.description: The pixel-scale band after over before: the noise.

noise_level.description: Noise level of the stack as a share of the mean.

residual.description: Deconvolution residual as a share of the mean, when there was one.

warning.description: A sentence for a person, when the verdict is not `fine`.

bayer_hint.description: Bayer pattern implied by the sidecar.

path.description: Sidecar path relative to the data root.

raw_colour.description: Whether the sidecar says the data is raw colour.

allOf.description:
The target time (`first`, `middle` (default), `last` or a UTC time), the
rotation law and the orientation of the images.

inputs.description:
Images (`.tif`, `.tiff`, `.png`, `.fits`) relative to the data root, one
to 200, each with the whole disc in view.

output.description:
Directory for the results, named `NAME-derotated.EXT`, relative to the
data root. Created when missing.

times.description:
UTC time of each input, in the order given. Without it a FITS file's
`DATE-AVG` or a file name with a full date and time is used; an input
with no time is an error.

images.description: The images, in the order given.

target.description: The time every image was brought to, UTC.

SourcedFlag.description: A switch and where its setting came from.

SourcedNumber.description: A number Helia uses and where it came from.

SourcedText.description: A value Helia uses and where it came from.

projected_msh.description: As seen, millionths of the visible hemisphere.

umbra_msh.description: Umbrae corrected, millionths of the hemisphere.

area_msh.description: Corrected for foreshortening, millionths of the hemisphere.

cmd_deg.description: Central meridian distance, degrees, west positive.

mu.description: Cosine of the angle from disc centre.

projected_msh.description: As seen, millionths of the visible hemisphere.

umbra_msh.description: Umbra corrected, millionths of the hemisphere.

SunspotsConfig.description: Tuning of the sunspot detection; every field is optional.

celestial_north_up.description:
The image has celestial north up: add the position angle P of the Sun
at the capture time to `north_angle_deg`.

group_gap_deg.description: Spots closer than this on the Sun, degrees, form one group. Default 3.

max_area.description:
Largest spot, millionths of the hemisphere; bigger dark regions are
left out as a cloud or vignette. Default 6000.

min_area.description: Smallest spot, millionths of the hemisphere. Default 2.

mirror.description: The image is a mirror image.

north_angle_deg.description:
Counter-clockwise angle from the top of the image to solar north,
degrees. Default 0.

penumbra.description: Penumbra threshold, a share of the quiet disc (0 to 1). Default 0.88.

umbra.description: Umbra threshold, a share of the quiet disc (0 to 1). Default 0.55.

wolf_k.description: Observer factor k of the Wolf number. Default 1.

SunspotsSummary.description: Sunspots on the stack: counts, areas and the table.

area_msh.description: Everything corrected for foreshortening, millionths of the hemisphere.

b0_deg.description: Heliographic latitude of the disc centre, degrees (needs `time`).

disc.description: Disc centre x, centre y and radius the positions are measured on, pixels.

l0_deg.description: Carrington longitude of the disc centre, degrees (needs `time`).

lines.description: The report in lines, as the command line prints it.

p_deg.description: Position angle of the solar axis, degrees (needs `time`).

projected_msh.description: Everything as seen, millionths of the visible hemisphere.

time.description: Capture time used, ISO 8601 UTC; absent when the capture had none.

umbra_msh.description: Umbrae corrected, millionths of the hemisphere.

TimelapseFrame.description: One frame of a finished time-lapse.

derotated_px.description:
The most the derotation moved the surface of this frame, pixels, when
it ran.

file.description: The frame file, relative to the data root.

gain.description: Gain applied for the brightness (1 without `deflicker`).

limb_confidence.description: Confidence of the frame's limb fit, 0 to 1, when it has one.

phase_psr.description: Peak-to-sidelobe ratio of the phase correlation, when it ran.

shift_x.description:
Shift applied, pixels (the frame's content was at the reference plus
this).

crop.description: Cut every frame to the area all of them cover.

deflicker_window.description: Frames in the running median of `smooth` (odd, at least 3; default 5).

oneOf.description:
Bring every frame to one time by the Sun's differential rotation (an
empty object for the defaults). Needs the time of every input.

fps.description: Frames a second of the movie (default 10, up to 120).

inputs.description:
Stacked images, relative to the data root, one per frame (2 to 200).
They are put in time order when every one has a time.

max_refine_px.description: Largest correction in pixels the refinement may make (default 3).

movie.description:
`auto` (default: MP4 when ffmpeg is installed, else an animated PNG),
`mp4`, `apng` or `none`.

output.description:
Directory for the frames, the movie and the table, relative to the data
root. Created when missing.

reference.description:
The frame the others are registered to: `first`, `middle` (default) or
a number counting from 1.

refine.description:
Refine the limb shift by phase correlation of the disc centre
(default true).

report.description:
Also write the diagnostics of the series into `output/report/`: how
each frame was registered, the brightness before and after
`deflicker`, and the derotation displacement, as PNG, CSV and JSON and
one self-contained `report.html` (`summary` `report`).

times.description:
UTC capture time of each input (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss`), in the order
given in `inputs`. Without it a FITS file's `DATE-AVG` or a file name
that holds a full date and time is used; frames with no time are kept
in the order given.

oneOf.description: The area of the stacked images that was kept, with `crop`.

movie.description: The movie file, relative to the data root, when one was made.

notes.description: Plain-language lines: what registration did, and any caveat.

report.description:
The diagnostics page (`report.html`), relative to the data root, with
`report`; its figures and data are beside it.

table.description: The registration table (CSV), relative to the data root.

channels.description: Red and blue against green; absent when `align_channels` was off.

gains.description:
Gains applied to red, green and blue, including the common scale that
keeps the picture inside white.

notes.description:
The notes written into the file's history, including warnings (a
channel held at the largest automatic gain, a shift not applied).

api.description: API version in the URL prefix.
